test_title: PYST 63: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a code language, ‘MARS’ is written as ‘KXPP’, and ‘BODY’ is written as ‘ZLBV’. How will ‘TEST’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For ‘MARS’ is coded as ‘KXPP’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9991e99fb01af804e03334e9d1145b3af0fe1722fb883e8e42469a754949c0c6.png] 

For ‘BODY’ is coded as ‘ZLBV’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56cb5328eeb70aa01549a24fd6ad5b9f7634734ac0d364bb4fbf96f14b7c524e.png] 

Similarly **‘TEST’ will be coded as 'RBQQ'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a97cd100c3c41c9d7cc6d3df0537fde5132159c5c88c630940028b1462f5189.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
